newsitem.title: USA: U.S. budget negotiations resume in morning session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. budget negotiations resume in morning session.

text.p: White House and congressional budget negotiators resume talks Friday morning at 10:00 a.m. EST (1400 GMT) aimed at reaching agreement on fiscal 1997 spending needed to keep the government running past the Oct. 1 start of the new financial year.

House and Senate Appropriations Committee leaders and staff met with White House Chief of Staff Leon Panetta and White House aides Thursday night in a bargaining session that concluded at 4:00 a.m. Friday (0800 GMT) without a final agreement.
A separate session on changes in immigration laws reached no agreement on that legislation. Democrats objected to restrictions on government services to legal immigrants.
